tracker_write_gate.title: Tracker write gate
tracker_write_gate.description: enforce (default) or off. enforce: the pre-tracker-write-gate hook refuses shared-container tracker writes that skipped the deciding commands. off: the tracker write gate stops refusing for this user and allows those writes, printing one stderr line naming the unchecked tickets. Any other value is treated as enforce.
